subject: Figurative constant values
notes: Rule: 'The all-literal format represents all or part of the string generated by successive concatenations of the characters comprising literal-1.' (cite.py --check 8.3.3.6.4 -> OK 9)). PROBES (probe/figurative-constant-values): p1.cob MOVE ALL "AB" TO PIC X(5) -> ABABA (a part of ABABAB...), MOVE ALL "7" TO PIC 9(3) -> 777 (with the 2023 obsolete warning of MOVE SR5), DISPLAY ALL "XY" -> XY (GR3 c length); p6.cob MOVE ALL "A" & "B" TO PIC X(6) -> ABABAB (literal-1 as a concatenation expression, SR2), MOVE ALL N"XY" TO PIC N(3) -> XYX. Landed siblings: PB71 (national/boolean), PB461 (one classifier), PB831 (implied picture). Golden pb71_all_national_boolean_figurative (and 2002/pb461_all_literal_value_categories) derive their values from this rule. || editions as written by the adjudicator: 85, 2002, 2014, 2023 (national and boolean literal-1 from 2002)
